pending.avail.blocked_other: {{count}} items have errors. Fix or remove them first.
pending.avail.loadingConfig: Checking whether publishing in one go is switched on.
pending.avail.nothing: Nothing is waiting to be published.
pending.avail.off: Publishing several steps at once is switched off on this server. Someone who runs it sets {{env}}=true and restarts it (see docs/api/pending.md). The single steps keep their own switches and still work meanwhile.
pending.avail.role: Publishing everything at once needs the admin or owner role. You can still look at what is pending.
pending.avail.stepsOff: The steps that what is pending waits for are switched off on this server ({{names}}). Each step needs its own switch, even in a batch.
pending.avail.unknown: Could not find out whether publishing in one go is switched on. Reload the page to try again.
pending.barText: {{waiting}}. Nothing is published until you review them.
pending.fail.disabled: Publishing several steps at once is switched off on this server. Someone who runs it sets {{env}}=true and restarts it. Nothing was done.
pending.fail.forbidden: Your role, or this token, does not allow every step in this plan. Nothing was done.
pending.fail.inProgress: Another publish for this app is running. Nothing was started. Wait for it to finish, then review again.
pending.fail.invalid: Those steps cannot be combined. Nothing was done.
pending.fail.mismatch: The text you typed does not match. Nothing was published.
pending.fail.network: The request failed. Check your connection, then review again.
pending.fail.notFound: That app is not here any more. Reload the page.
pending.fail.planChanged: The staged changes or the store changed since you reviewed the plan, so nothing was published. Review the new plan.
pending.fail.refused: The request was refused ({{status}}). Nothing was done.
pending.fail.server: The server had a problem. Nothing was retried. Review again to see where things stand.
pending.fail.stepDisabled: A step in this plan is switched off on this server. Each step needs its own switch. Nothing was done. Review again.
pending.fail.tooMany: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then review again.
pending.failed.assetChanged: A staged file changed. Stage it again, then review.
pending.failed.assetUnreadable: A staged file cannot be read. Stage it again, then review.
pending.failed.blocked: Nothing was written: a check blocks this step now. Review again.
pending.failed.changesInReview: The store refuses this while changes are in review. Nothing was sent.
pending.failed.confirmationMismatch: The confirmation did not match. Nothing was written.
pending.failed.draftPartial: Only part of it reached the draft. What was written stays there. Review again to finish: items that already match are skipped.
pending.failed.noEditableVersion: The store has no version that can be edited. Create one in the store console.
pending.failed.nothingPushed: No pushed draft is waiting to be submitted.
pending.failed.outcomeUnknown: It is not known whether this reached the store. Look at the app in the store console, then review again.
pending.failed.rateLimited: The store asked for a pause. Nothing was retried. Wait a moment, then review again.
pending.failed.stagedInvalid: A staged item has an error. Fix it, then review.
pending.failed.stateChanged: Nothing was written: the store or the staged changes changed after the preview. Review again.
pending.failed.stepError: The step stopped unexpectedly. Look at the app in the store, then review again.
pending.failed.storeAuth: The store did not accept the credential. Check it in Credentials.
pending.failed.storeForbidden: The store credential is not allowed to do this. Check its role in the store.
pending.failed.storeNotFound: The store could not find what this step acts on. Sync the app and review again.
pending.failed.storeUnavailable: The store could not be reached. Review again to check where things stand.
pending.failed.timeout: The store did not answer in time. Review again to check where things stand.
pending.failed.writeFailed: The store did not accept the write.
pending.failed.writeInProgress: Another write for this app was running, so nothing was written. Wait for it, then review again.
pending.next.invalid: Cannot be pushed until the error is fixed.
pending.next.none: Nothing to do here. The store is reviewing it.
pending.next.push: Next: push it to the store as a draft. A push does not submit anything.
pending.next.releaseApproved: Next: release the approved version to users.
pending.next.releaseDraft: Next: release the draft to users. You name the share of users and confirm it first.
pending.next.rollout: Next: make the rollout change that is due.
pending.next.submit: Next: submit the draft for the store review.
pending.outcome.notApplied: Nothing was changed (read back from the store).
pending.promise.none: The details are checked again when this step runs.
pending.result.allDone: Everything in the plan was done
pending.result.doneConfirmed: Done, confirmed by reading the store back.
pending.row.forbidden: Your role, or this token, does not allow {{action}}.
pending.row.needsDetails: This step needs details. Use the single step under “Do just one step (advanced)”.
pending.row.notRequested: Not part of this publish. Tick it to include it.
pending.row.rolloutSingle: A rollout change names the release and the share. Use the single step under “Do just one step (advanced)”.
pending.row.switchedOff: Switched off on this server ({{env}}). Each step needs its own switch, even in a batch.
pending.skipped.blocked: Not run: something now stands in the way of this step. Review again.
pending.skipped.planDrifted: Not run: it no longer matched what you reviewed. Review again.
pending.skipped.previewFailed: Not run: the store could not be read for this step. Review again.
pending.skipped.previousStepNotApplied: Not run, because an earlier step did not finish.
pending.stopNote: The steps run in order and stop at the first one that is not done. The steps after it were not run, and nothing is retried automatically.
